name: East Valley Fire Cadet Program
what_you_do: Learn basic firefighting skills, CPR and first aid. Practice climbing ladders and working hose lines. Build teamwork and leadership skills.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18, and you must be in school. Keep a C average. You need medical clearance before starting.
pay_detail: Cost is not stated on the program page.
duration: Not stated on the program page. Most meetings are held at the Public Safety Training Facility, 3260 North 40th Street, Mesa.
deadline_text: Sign-up is once a year in August. The 2026-2027 sign-up is closed. The page says to check back on August 1, 2027.
how_to_apply: Sign up during the August window on the program page. For questions, contact Program Coordinator Christine Mendoza. The page shows 480-644-5047 and 480-644-3883, so confirm before calling.
notes: The work is hard on the body. Cadets lift, pull or push up to 75 lbs. Community service is strongly encouraged but not required.
